g.title: Reading Roulette — static layered v09 reconstruction
g.desc: An illustrated reading machine assembled from individual transparent artwork layers, nineteen individual keys, three parchment cylinders and independent SVG typography. No functionality or animation.

g.title: Contact shadow beneath the assembled machine
Separate drawn fields and selectable text; static appearance
Three independent parchment cylinders behind the metal cradle
Independent neighboring rows and selected content
Live text on the burgundy label strip
Nineteen separate keycap instances, each with its own text
Separate SPIN lettering and refresh arrow
Independent heading, ornament and subtitle
g.text: Try your luck. Find your next great read.
Write an original reading text entirely in English for a language learner.
Difficulty target: B1+ (an internal tuning point around the standard CEFR levels,
not a separate official CEFR level). Use B1 language with richer descriptions,
more varied connectors, and occasional complex sentences.
Topic: Travel. Exploring a new place and its local culture.
Format: Short story. A self-contained story with a clear beginning and ending.
Choose a natural narrative perspective and a tone that suits the angle.
Angle: Unexpected discovery. Focus on discovering something surprising that
changes how the topic is understood.
Use a register, emotional tone, and narrative perspective appropriate to the
format and angle. Keep formal documents neutral.
Keep vocabulary, grammar, and sentence complexity within the selected difficulty
target, even when the topic or angle is complex. Prefer simpler language over
simplifying or changing the requested topic, format, or angle.
Return only the reading text, without translations, exercises, or commentary.
Paste into your preferred AI chat.
